name: Doorway Chest Stretch
steps: Stand in the middle of an open doorway.
Place both forearms on the doorframe with your elbows bent at roughly 90 degrees at shoulder height.
Step one foot forward through the doorway until you feel a gentle, comfortable stretch across your chest and front shoulders.
Keep your torso upright and core lightly engaged; do not arch your lower back.
Hold the stretch steady for 20 to 30 seconds while taking slow, deep diaphragmatic breaths, then step back.
coaching_cues: The stretch should feel pleasant and relieving, never sharp or pinching.
Vary elbow height slightly (above or below shoulder height) to target different fibers of the pectoral muscles.
Avoid letting your head jut forward during the stretch.

sources.attribution: Mayo Clinic Stretching and Flexibility Exercises
